name: 神谷神社本殿
checkpoints: THREE front bays, one flowing nagare gable roof extended forward over a narrow entrance veranda and stairs.
Raised timber body, round main columns, square porch columns, surrounding veranda and central stair; simple undecorated dark timber plank doors.
Exclude trees, outer enclosure, modern signs; retain stone platform.
